Indeterminate — The reported video ad and the leftover banner background do not appear on ootrandomizer.com when the reporter's own filter lists are applied:⁠ the Raptive/AdThrive loader is blocked, the ad slots render empty at zero size, and full-page vision found neither annotated target. Recommend closing as not reproduced; the only ad-recovery path on the page (html-load.com) is already neutralized because Base filter redirects the detection probe to noopjs.

## Policy rationale

The reported ads are served by a third-party ad network (Raptive/AdThrive), not the site's own advertising, so the first-party-ads policy does not apply. The report is not a paywall and not a German anti-adblock wall, and the page shows no anti-adblock message, so none of the no-rule policy clauses closes it. No policy clause blocks rule generation; the close is recommended on non-reproduction of the reported defect on the loaded page with the reporter's filter set.
